extraction_rules.first_release_rule: For each observation period, select the earliest source vintage/release containing that observation.
extraction_rules.revision_rule: Later revisions are separate later information events; never overwrite earlier checkpoints.
extraction_rules.scale_rule: Compare changes/impulses rather than absolute index levels if rebasing/reference-year changes make levels incomparable across vintages.
extraction_rules.missing_rule: If a vintage is absent in the official archive, mark WITHHELD_PIT for that checkpoint; do not interpolate vintage values.
